Portfolio simplification; potential re-rating toward core motion tech.
Cash proceeds unknown; limits valuation impact assessment near term.
Signals exit of lower-margin line; could lift consolidated profitability.
Time-bound benefit guides expectations; not immediate to FY26.
Proceeds may fund capex, M&A, debt paydown or returns.
